safety.hear_timeout: Each poll performs one bounded check. After 100000 unsuccessful polls it returns -5, preserves pending and refuses release/start/run. Late real completion captures a timeout mismatch instead of overwriting timeout as PASS.
safety.storage: Static backups, inputs and result arrays; no hundreds-word automatic arrays. Done means completed execution, not PASS. Result and raw vMag capture retained until drain/release.
safety.concurrency_limit: Guards are sequential lifecycle guards, not atomic locking. Explicit caller quiescence remains required.
